## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game inspired by Roblox-style animal feeding/simulator games, using a polished meadow setting and food-tossing gameplay.

## Requirements
- Complete the build without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript implementation.
- Present the game as “Snack Safari,” with a bright illustrated field-guide aesthetic.
